description.value: Yiamas Greek Taverna is a full-service traditional Greek restaurant in Courtenay in the Comox Valley, offering hearty classics like souvlaki, moussaka, spanakopita, and fire-grilled seafood for both lunch and dinner. The restaurant prides itself on traditional Greek hospitality and shareable dishes, and its expansive menu makes it a satisfying sit-down stop after a long day on the bike. Takeout is also available for cyclists who prefer to eat on the go.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces) at 30m; rack (2 spaces) at 64m; bollard (10 spaces) at 69m; rack (2 spaces) at 96m. Total: 18 spaces.
